posts.title: The advice I don't give juniors
posts.description: Twenty-five years of technical advice has mostly expired. What's left worth passing on is the short list of things that never moved: the domain, working backward, reading, and trust.

posts.title: Don't outsource the thinking
posts.description: Developers are starting to refuse to work without AI. The tools were never the problem — handing over the part that thinks is.

posts.title: Modeling the domain first
posts.description: Why I reach for the domain model before the framework, the database, or the API.
